comment: The two CV jacks are inverting: MPEGCore.cc:219 sets CVInputFullScaleInV to -10V, so a positive voltage moves the setting down and a negative one up. The ENV output is built the same way, from a -20V span with a +10V offset (MPEGCore.cc:221-222). The menu's option lists map onto the firmware's own enumerations at MPEGCore.cc:198-212 and flash_user.hh:13-41. The source carries a comment at MPEGCore.cc:203 doubting the cycle-jack mapping, and another at MPEGCore.cc:154 saying the ping input's low-pass filtering has not been modelled.
